items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Because I know he used to tell Joe Harris all the time, don't draw your arm, you're not going to punch nobody.

ctx.x: Use a method. You hold the trombone in this finger between the first finger and the thumb. And you hold a slide between the two first and second finger and the thumb. Don't put your grasp it like that. You hold it with your two first finger. The tips of the finger. Just the tip of the finger and use the wrist, not the entire arm. The only time that you would stretch your arm if you make a note in the sixth position. But from the first position down to the fourth, you just use your wrist. Just let your arm be a…
Now how did that work with the placement on your lips? Where would you put your mouthpiece on your lips?
